questions.q: Which 1389 battle against the Ottomans is central to Serbian identity?
questions.why: Prince Lazar died in it.

questions.q: Whose 1914 shooting of Archduke Franz Ferdinand started the First World War?
questions.why: He was a Bosnian Serb.

questions.q: Which country did Serbia form with others in 1918?
questions.a: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (later Yugoslavia)
questions.why: It was renamed Yugoslavia in 1929.

questions.q: Who led Yugoslavia from 1945 to 1980?
questions.why: He kept Yugoslavia apart from the Soviet bloc.

questions.q: Which medieval king's empire was at its height in the 1300s?
questions.why: He was crowned emperor in 1346.

questions.q: Which prince founded the Nemanjić dynasty in the 1100s?
questions.why: His son Sava founded the Serbian Church.

questions.q: Which saint founded the independent Serbian Orthodox Church in 1219?
questions.why: A huge temple in Belgrade honours him.

questions.q: Which 1804 uprising began Serbia's fight for independence?
questions.why: Karađorđe led it.

questions.q: Which President was overthrown in 2000 and tried at The Hague?
questions.why: He died during his trial.

questions.q: Which medieval monastery with a white marble church is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Stefan Nemanja founded it.

questions.q: What is the capital of Serbia?
questions.why: It sits where the Sava meets the Danube.

questions.q: Which trumpet festival in a small village draws huge crowds?
questions.why: It celebrates brass bands.

questions.q: Which national park on the Danube has the Iron Gates gorge?
questions.why: It is on the border with Romania.

questions.q: Which Serbian tennis player has won a record 24 Grand Slam titles?
questions.why: He also won Olympic gold in 2024.

questions.q: Which sport has Serbia won many world and Olympic titles in?
questions.why: It won Olympic gold in 2016, 2020 and 2024.

questions.q: Which Serbian basketball star won NBA MVP three times?
questions.why: He plays for the Denver Nuggets.

questions.q: Which music festival is held in Petrovaradin Fortress in Novi Sad?
questions.why: It began in 2000 as a student protest.

questions.q: Which film director won two Palmes d'Or?
questions.why: He won for 'When Father Was Away on Business' and 'Underground'.

questions.q: Which Nobel winner wrote 'The Bridge on the Drina'?
questions.why: He won the prize in 1961.

questions.q: Which Serbian-American inventor developed alternating current systems?
questions.why: Belgrade's airport is named after him.

questions.q: Which scientist explained ice ages with cycles of Earth's orbit?
questions.why: The cycles are named after him.

questions.q: In which year did Serbia gain full international recognition at the Congress of Berlin?
questions.why: It became a kingdom in 1882.

questions.q: Which reformer standardised the Serbian language and Cyrillic alphabet?
questions.why: He followed the rule 'write as you speak'.

questions.q: What is Serbia's currency?
questions.why: Its code is RSD.

questions.q: Which fortress overlooks the meeting of the Sava and Danube?
questions.why: It has been fought over many times.

questions.q: Which grilled minced-meat rolls are a Serbian favourite?
questions.why: They are served with onions and flatbread.

questions.q: Which plum brandy is Serbia's national drink?
questions.why: UNESCO listed it in 2022.

questions.q: Which cheese spread like cream is eaten with bread?
questions.why: It is made from milk skin.

questions.q: Which red pepper relish is popular in Serbia?
questions.why: Families make it in autumn.

questions.q: Which huge church in Belgrade is one of the largest Orthodox churches?
questions.why: It stands on the Vračar plateau.
